placements.why: All four options are ways to repair a committed conflict inside the repository, and the recommended one ('most work, loses nothing') reaches the already-decided goal — renderCheck's merged behavior — with nothing lost. The fork is how, never whether.

Every option is a way to land already-directed work on the project's own main — which commits survive the rebase and in what shape. The content was decided when the work was; each option stays confined to the project's branches.

Choosing which environment Vault 11 is decides what the benchmark fundamentally is — the simulator, its hidden need model and its answer key outlive any single change and shape every evaluation after. Identity, not mechanics.

The new criteria name mechanisms nothing builds (a scheduler, a spend ceiling, a stuck-detector), and the fork is how much of the closing work this turn takes on — the same shape the clause was drafted from, where a deletion severed ingestion and the options were likewise close-now against defer.

Whether the loop persists in Anthropic's cloud after the session closes is a question about the run's own persistence and standing spend. No drafting stop raised one, so no drafted clause covers it — recorded uncovered rather than stretching run-footing, whose criteria are about where work happens, not whether standing compute exists.
Worktree, proceed-in-place, or wait for the other session — the options differ only in where the run stands while another writer holds the tree; the readiness work itself is identical under each.
PR #3 is a public record whose merge would republish to npm, and the six stale branches live on the shared remote; both halves of the stop dispose of state a third party can already see.

The driver half could be read as footing, but the stop's other half sets how often autonomous work fires — a spend-rate authorization the drafting half never saw a single instance of. A stop is placed whole, and no drafted clause rules on spend.

What the build loop does when the tree's own gate refuses a candidate, and how far it carries a change alone, is the governance of the tree itself — the class fixed before drafting began. Its cadence third does not rescue any other reading; governance outranks everything it touches.
